explanation: Matches the question on erdosproblems.com/1088: for each fixed n ≥ 3, f_d(n) = 2^{o(d)} as d → ∞, encoded as log₂ f_d(n) = o(d). f_d(n) is the least m such that every m-point set in ℝ^d has an n-subset with all C(n,2) distances distinct, which matches the page. As a check, the known f_d(3) = d²/2 + O(d) is consistent with the conjecture at n = 3.
